verdict.rationale: Speculative decoding is a fair performance question for a local LLM inference runtime like Ollama, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents speculative decoding, draft models, or any similar acceleration technique. The community benchmark covers quantization formats (nvfp4, int4), which is a different technique, and gets no credit here.
